metadata.purpose: W1.2 probe: proves WorkspaceMenuSeeder's default reconcile mode actually re-projects a menu-seed change onto an already-seeded workspace_v1_menus table across a real reboot against the SAME database -- insert a new row, update a changed row, preserve a user-edited row's prior content as a flagged override (D7: model wins), remove a row the fresh seed no longer declares, and leave an unrelated row untouched. Input/packs/workspace/pack.json is a COPY of NPDevContract/packs/workspace/pack.json (validate-corpus.py refuses a model-root-escaping $ref, the same convention p6-satellite-extension's identity pack copy already follows) -- keep it in sync with the canonical pack whenever Menu's seedKey/seedOrigin/seedFingerprint/overrideOf fields (workspace pack 1.1.0, W1.2) change.
